title: Faith when nothing makes sense

scenes.say: Some seasons will not make sense right now.
scenes.visual: a man sitting alone on a wooden bench in an empty park at dusk, cool blue light, quiet mood

scenes.say: You pray, you work, and the door still stays shut.
scenes.visual: a closed wooden door at the end of a dim hallway, a thin line of warm light underneath

scenes.say: That is not proof you are forgotten.
scenes.visual: a man looking up at a cloudy night sky from a rooftop, city lights soft below, calm mood

scenes.say: Faith is moving forward before you see the reason.
scenes.visual: a man walking down a foggy road at dawn, seen from behind, faint golden light ahead

scenes.say: Keep showing up for the small things you can control.
scenes.visual: hands lacing up worn running shoes on a front step in early morning light

scenes.say: Make the bed, do the work, keep your word.
scenes.visual: a neatly made bed in a simple room with sunlight coming through the window

scenes.say: One day the picture comes together and you understand.
scenes.visual: the same park bench at sunrise, warm golden light spilling across the grass, hopeful mood

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a man standing on a hill facing the rising sun, arms relaxed at his sides, seen from behind

caption: You do not have to understand the season to keep walking through it. Keep the faith and keep doing the work.
